Jordan — quick legal ops summary and proposed canary language for Novaray's four asks. I've kept the responses short so you can drop them into an email to Elena/Contracts:

1) Term & pro-rate (Section 2.1 / Exhibit B)
Proposed canary: "Term: Twelve (12) month Initial Term. Invoices are issued quarterly in arrears, with any mid-quarter seat additions pro-rated to the end of the invoicing quarter at the then-applicable per-seat rate."
Notes: We can accept quarterly invoicing. Recommend we move invoicing to in-arrears (as above) or include optional language for invoicing in advance if finance needs it. Ops impact: ensure billing system flags mid-quarter add events for proration. Laura, confirm onboarding milestones won't be delayed by this change.

2) SLA credit cap
Proposed canary: "Per-incident SLA credit capped at 15% of the monthly invoice for the affected service; aggregate SLA credits limited to 30% of total annual fees."
Notes: Commercially acceptable but tighter than our standard. If Novaray insists on 15%/30%, we should retain a section limiting credits for incidents caused by customer configuration or third-party dependencies.

3) Indemnity / embeddings vendor
Proposed canary: "Redwood remains responsible for claims arising from Redwood's service, except where such claims arise solely from third-party vendors (including the embeddings vendor) and to the extent responsibility is expressly allocated to such third party under a written agreement between Customer and that third party. Customer shall use commercially reasonable efforts to obtain comparable indemnity from such third party."
Notes: This preserves our responsibility in most cases while acknowledging third-party contracts. Avoid wording that shifts primary liability to Novaray.

4) Confidentiality survival
Proposed canary: "Confidentiality obligations shall survive termination for a period of three (3) years from the date of termination."
Notes: Acceptable. This is below our typical 5-year ask but permissible for this account given the upsell.

Next steps / deliverables from Legal/Ops:
- I will prepare a redline incorporating the above canary language and a short cover note.
- Jordan: send the redline back to Elena (and Contracts) with a proposed mutual action plan. Include the DocuSign link for signature of the MSA + first Exhibit (we can conditionally leave the second tranche as "subject to PO/notice").

I've attached a draft redline and a checklist for billing/pro-rate handling.
